topic: policy choice matters per direction, but not the way the microbenchmark suggested
finding: v20 used NORMAL_LV on the read path (the microbenchmark winner at 2.35 TB/s) and NORMAL_FV on the write path. Prefill regressed from v18 0.064779 to 0.069899 ms even though only the read policy changed, so in the real kernel NORMAL_FV is the better read policy as well. Microbenchmark rankings do not transfer directly to the fused kernel.
decode_note: decode improved from v16 1.3160x to v20 1.3497x, because the looped fallback path now also carries the policy
next: v21 applies NORMAL_FV on every DMA path (all four copies) and is correctness-clean; its gate is pending
